'''Sweitt Concorkill''' was a [[Vurk]] [[senator]] for the [[Galactic Republic]] [[Galactic Senate|Senate]] and a renowned [[diplomat]] with a long career who joined the [[Delegation of 2,000]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. In [[19 BBY]], Concorkill spoke with [[Jedi Master]] [[Coleman Kcaj]] before attending a performance of ''[[Squid Lake]]'' at the [[Galaxies Opera House]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] and sat in the private box of [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]], who he mistakenly believed he could convince to relinquish authority. [[Halland Goth]], a member of Palpatine's [[Emperor's Royal Guard|personal guard]], later recalled Concorkill as possibly being the senator for [[Sembla]], the Vurk [[homeworld]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Palpatine dismissed his party—there was Mas Amedda, and his chief of staff, Sly Moore. And a senator from Sembla, I think. Palpatine sent them away, and Shalk escorted them out.|Halland Goth|<ref name="MOE">''[[Master of Evil]]''</ref>}}
Sweitt Concorkill was a [[Vurk]] [[senator]] who served in the [[Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars]].<ref name="VE" /> Over a long career he negotiated many truces and deescalated many conflicts, earning a reputation as a renowned [[diplomat]].<ref name="Dawn" /> Concorkill joined the [[Delegation of 2,000]], a group of senators who were concerned with [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine's]] continued use of emergency powers during the war.<ref name="VE" />

[[File:Palpatines_private_viewing_box.png|thumb|left|250px|alt=Sweitt Concorkill sits in a chair beside Mas Amedda in Palpatine's private box atthe Galaxies Opera House. Behind the Vurk, Anakin Skywalker enters the box as Halland Goth stands guard beside the door.|Sweitt Concorkill watches ''Squid Lake'' in the Chancellor's private box.]]
Shortly after the [[Battle of Coruscant]]<ref name="Episode III" /> in [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY]].</ref> Concorkill attended a performance of the [[opera]] ''[[Squid Lake]]'' at the [[Galaxies Opera House]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]. Before the performance commenced, he conversed with [[Jedi Master]] [[Coleman Kcaj]] outside the opera house. The senator then sat in Palpatine's private viewing box along with<ref name="Episode III" /> [[Vice Chair]]<ref name="VE" /> [[Mas Amedda]],<ref name="Episode III" /> senior administrative [[aide]]<ref name="VE" /> [[Sly Moore]], and the Supreme Chancellor himself.<ref name="Episode III" /> The party was accompanied by two members of Palpatine's [[Emperor's Royal Guard|personal guard]], [[Halland Goth]] and [[Lieutenant]] [[Cempo Shalk]].<ref name="MOE" />

Midway through the performance, Palpatine calmly dismissed Concorkill, Amedda, and Moore from the box upon the arrival of [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]], whom Palpatine had invited to watch the opera with him.<ref name="Episode III" /> Shalk then escorted Concorkill and the others out,<ref name="MOE" /> leaving Palpatine and Skywalker to have a private conversation on matters relating to knowledge of [[the Force]].<ref name="Episode III" /> Later that [[Standard year|year]],<ref name="Date">The events of ''[[Master of Evil]]'' begin during the events of [[Darth Vader (2017) 5|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 5]] and then spans to before the events of [[Darth Vader (2017) 6|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 6]], which corresponds to [[19 BBY]] per ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''.</ref> after the Republic [[Proclamation of the New Order|transitioned]] into the [[Galactic Empire]] with Palpatine as its [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]], Goth told his [[TC-series protocol droid]] [[TC-99]] about Skywalker and Palpatine's interaction at the opera house, recalling Concorkill only as possibly being the senator for [[Sembla]],<ref name="MOE" /> the Vurk [[homeworld]].<ref name="Power">''[[Unlimited Power]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Concorkill had [[Color|green]] skin and light-blue [[eye]]s.<ref name="Episode III" /> A skilled diplomat, he mistakenly believed that he could talk Palpatine into relinquishing his authority.<ref name="Dawn" /> When Palpatine asked Concorkill to leave his box in the opera house,<ref name="Episode III" /> the Vurk did so with meditative grace.<ref name="ROTSAD">{{Film|III}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> 

==Equipment==
The senator was elegantly clad<ref name="ROTSAD" /> in a red-and-white-patterned [[Clothing|robes]] while at the opera,<ref name="Episode III" /> very similar to those worn by [[Junior Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks]].<ref name="VE" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Coleman_Kcaj.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Ongree Jedi Coleman Kcaj sits in lower chair in the Jedi High Council Chamber.|Sweitt Concorkill was originally the Ongree character that became Coleman Kcaj (pictured).]]
Sweitt Concorkill first appeared in the [[2005]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], the final installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]].<ref name="Episode III" /> For the new ''Star Wars'' [[canon]], the character was first identified by name in [[2016]] by the [[Star Wars: Card Trader|''Star Wars'': Card Trader]] app.<ref name="SWCT">{{SWCT|set=Base Series 3|cardname=Senator Sweitt Concorkill}}</ref> That name had originally been introduced in the 2005 [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

Concorkill was originally meant to be an [[Ongree]] senator based on the design of character [[Pablo-Jill]] from [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]. However, once the Pablo-Jill model was redesigned for ''Revenge of the Sith'', the Ongree senator's clothes were changed to [[Jedi apparel|Jedi robes]], and the character was renamed Coleman Kcaj. As a result, the name Sweitt Concorkill was mistakenly applied to an image of Kcaj in ''Revenge of the Sith The Visual Dictionary''.<ref name="Jedi Roster">{{Blog|holocron|11|Jedi High Council Roster}}</ref> This error was ultimately rectified for ''Star Wars'' Legends in the 2005 [[Star Wars Insider 85|''Star Wars Insider'' 85]] article "[[Who's Who in the Delegation of 2000]]," written by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|85|Who's Who in the Delegation of 2000}}</ref>
